snippet.title: ♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.5 PV | Where All Souls Return
snippet.description:
♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.5 PV | Where All Souls Return

The Boneyard—birthplace of the God of Reincarnation.
Dragon remains bear witness to an undying mark.
The ancient ocarina guides souls to the beyond.

The tides ebb and flow, as desolation gives way to bloom.
This long journey—a fool's errand, or an eternal vigil?

Infinity Nikki Version 2.5, "Where All Souls Return," launches on April 23 (UTC-7)!
The new main quest "Where All Souls Return" will open, along with the new region Boneyard and the new dungeon Soul Tide! Unlock new abilities for your adventures, try fresh gameplay features, and enjoy generous rewards. Stylists, get ready to dive in!

——
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.5 Where All Souls Return launches globally on April 23 (UTC-7) !
